p18/esc1252:0.speaker: supporter
p18/esc1252:0.text: Hi! Hope you are doing well?

p18/esc1252:10.speaker: supporter
p18/esc1252:10.text: Family comes first. I would do anything to save my marriage as you are doing. I am proud of you. I am pretty sure you both love each other more than anything.

p18/esc1252:11.speaker: seeker
p18/esc1252:11.text: Yes my wife is everything to me and can not imagine loosing her due to some avoidable reasons

p18/esc1252:12.speaker: supporter
p18/esc1252:12.text: That should be the spirit. Now nothing can make you apart. Drinking is very easy for you to quit now. you will definitely get a success.

p18/esc1252:14.speaker: supporter
p18/esc1252:14.text: No problem! That's why I am here to help you. Have a wonderful life ahead!

p18/esc1252:15.speaker: seeker
p18/esc1252:15.text: Any other general advice you may have for me

p18/esc1252:16.speaker: supporter
p18/esc1252:16.text: Just stick to the plan. Spend more time together. Cook dinner for her. Make a strong bond and my best wishes are there for you .

p18/esc1252:17.speaker: seeker
p18/esc1252:17.text: Wow that is some wonderful advice right there. thank you for that..Any other tips to spice things up

p18/esc1252:18.speaker: supporter
p18/esc1252:18.text: You both can go for a date or do the things what your partner like. Drinking is luring so stay away from that and you can do it.

p18/esc1252:19.speaker: seeker
p18/esc1252:19.text: Thank you I will definitely avoid drinking and any thing else that may contribute to such kind of issues

p18/esc1252:2.speaker: supporter
p18/esc1252:2.text: Glad to know that you are doing well. How may I assist you today ?

p18/esc1252:20.speaker: supporter
p18/esc1252:20.text: It seems you got the solution. have a wonderful time.

p18/esc1252:21.speaker: seeker
p18/esc1252:21.text: Thank you for the assistance. Really appreciates

p18/esc1252:3.speaker: seeker
p18/esc1252:3.text: I had a drinking challenge which has been affecting my marriage for quit sometime now

p18/esc1252:4.speaker: supporter
p18/esc1252:4.text: So as far as I understand that you had issues with your wife due to your drinking. Am I right?

p18/esc1252:6.speaker: supporter
p18/esc1252:6.text: That is really a serious problem. I know it must be very tough time for you. Hope you are trying your best to save your marriage.

p18/esc1252:7.speaker: seeker
p18/esc1252:7.text: Yes I have really reduced my drinking to ensure I save my marriage

p18/esc1252:8.speaker: supporter
p18/esc1252:8.text: That's is a great initiative. I know it is tough for you but not impossible. I can feel how hard you are trying t save your relationship. I appreciate you for that.

p18/esc1252:9.speaker: seeker
p18/esc1252:9.text: Thank you for the encouragement. Will do everything I can to save the situation

p18/esc552:1.speaker: seeker
p18/esc552:1.text: Im feeling down and need some advice as to how do I handle this situation

p18/esc552:11.speaker: supporter
p18/esc552:11.text: Can you tell me some examples about the injustice?

p18/esc552:12.speaker: seeker
p18/esc552:12.text: Some colleagues are given an option to log out early, whereas some of us have to slog .

p18/esc552:13.speaker: supporter
p18/esc552:13.text: Is the logging out early a reward for their work? I had a job that offered similar rewards based on performance.

p18/esc552:14.speaker: seeker
p18/esc552:14.text: No, it's a privilege given to them if they agree to anything the Manger says like going out with him for a drink, etc..

p18/esc552:15.speaker: supporter
p18/esc552:15.text: That is very inappropriate. This must be very hard for you.

p18/esc552:16.speaker: seeker
p18/esc552:16.text: It is, I try to let it go, but fail at times.

p18/esc552:17.speaker: supporter
p18/esc552:17.text: If your manager has a supervisor that you feel would not approve of this behavior, I would speak to them. If you don't feel that would be beneficial to you, you could reach out to your company HR department.

p18/esc552:18.speaker: seeker
p18/esc552:18.text: Yes, I have that as my last resort. What do you think? Should I go ahead as I'm afraid my step may backfire me.

p18/esc552:19.speaker: supporter
p18/esc552:19.text: I would not be able to let this go either. I'm so sorry you're in such an unfair and unethical work environment. Do you know the supervisor well or interact with them? It could backfire if they both interact with this behavior. I believe you will make the right decision. If it does backfire, this is a toxic work environment and not a good fit for you.

p18/esc552:22.speaker: seeker
p18/esc552:22.text: Feels better when you share with someone who has similar experience and can understand your situation

p18/esc552:23.speaker: supporter
p18/esc552:23.text: You are very welcome. It does feel good to communicate with people who can understand how you feel. I wish you the very best of luck.

p18/esc552:24.speaker: seeker
p18/esc552:24.text: Thank you so much. Take care. Be safe.

p18/esc552:25.speaker: supporter
p18/esc552:25.text: You're welcome. You be safe as well.

p18/esc552:5.speaker: supporter
p18/esc552:5.text: I'm doing well. Ok I can help. Whats going on?

p18/esc552:6.speaker: seeker
p18/esc552:6.text: It's to do with some of my peers who hardly work but are favorable to my Manager as they always say yes to his word.

p18/esc552:7.speaker: supporter
p18/esc552:7.text: It sounds like you are unsure of how to deal with favoritism in the workplace. I have dealt with similar situations.

p18/esc552:8.speaker: seeker
p18/esc552:8.text: Yes, it bothers me as I cannot tolerate injustice

p18/esc982:0.speaker: supporter
p18/esc982:0.text: Hello, how are you feeling today?

p18/esc982:10.speaker: supporter
p18/esc982:10.text: That's wonderful that you're very open, I'm sure you will be well in no time. If you still have a hard time sleeping, feel free to contact us again. We'll be happy to help.

p18/esc982:11.speaker: seeker
p18/esc982:11.text: ya.sure.thanks you very much for the help

p18/esc982:12.speaker: supporter
p18/esc982:12.text: You're welcome! Have a nice day.

p18/esc982:13.speaker: seeker
p18/esc982:13.text: thank you so much .have a nice day

p18/esc982:14.speaker: supporter
p18/esc982:14.text: Stay safe and try doing naps first.

p18/esc982:15.speaker: seeker
p18/esc982:15.text: i decided to to yoga for better sleep

p18/esc982:16.speaker: supporter
p18/esc982:16.text: that's wonderful. how did it go?

p18/esc982:18.speaker: supporter
p18/esc982:18.text: That's wonderful. I also kept on doing yoga.

p18/esc982:2.speaker: supporter
p18/esc982:2.text: I'm so sorry to hear that. Is there any particular reason you feel upset today?

p18/esc982:4.speaker: supporter
p18/esc982:4.text: That's really hard, but I'm sure we can find a way to make your sleeping more at ease. Has it been happening frequently?

p18/esc982:5.speaker: seeker
p18/esc982:5.text: yes.the problem occurs me daily night

p18/esc982:6.speaker: supporter
p18/esc982:6.text: I had a problem sleeping before, is it ok if I give you some suggestions that helped me and might help you too?

p18/esc982:7.speaker: seeker
p18/esc982:7.text: yes.sure i am ready to get suggetions from you

p18/esc982:8.speaker: supporter
p18/esc982:8.text: Try practicing meditation and yoga, and avoid mobile phones atleast an hour before you sleep. Chamomile tea also helped me relaxed before.

p18/esc982:9.speaker: seeker
p18/esc982:9.text: ok.its very good advice .i will follow these steps surely

p18/p18_conv_1:1.speaker: supporter
p18/p18_conv_1:1.text: Hi John, yes, I'm here. How are things going?

p18/p18_conv_1:10.speaker: seeker
p18/p18_conv_1:10.text: Honestly, I don't think I've been taking care of myself as much as I should. I'm just exhausted.

p18/p18_conv_1:11.speaker: supporter
p18/p18_conv_1:11.text: It's understandable to feel that way. Finding a bit of time for yourself could help, even if it's just small breaks.

p18/p18_conv_1:12.speaker: seeker
p18/p18_conv_1:12.text: Yeah, I guess I need to be better about that. It's just hard to let myself relax when there's so much to do.

p18/p18_conv_1:13.speaker: supporter
p18/p18_conv_1:13.text: It's tough to prioritize yourself, but remember your well-being matters too. Maybe there's a small activity you enjoy that could give you some peace.

p18/p18_conv_1:14.speaker: seeker
p18/p18_conv_1:14.text: I used to enjoy going for walks. Maybe I could start doing that again.

p18/p18_conv_1:15.speaker: supporter
p18/p18_conv_1:15.text: That sounds like a wonderful idea. A little fresh air and movement can be refreshing.

p18/p18_conv_1:16.speaker: seeker
p18/p18_conv_1:16.text: Thanks, I'll try to make time for it. I just want to be there for my mom as much as I can.

p18/p18_conv_1:17.speaker: supporter
p18/p18_conv_1:17.text: The love and care you’re giving her is invaluable. It’s clear how much she means to you.

p18/p18_conv_1:18.speaker: seeker
p18/p18_conv_1:18.text: She does. It's difficult to see her like this, but I'm trying my best.

p18/p18_conv_1:19.speaker: supporter
p18/p18_conv_1:19.text: Your effort and dedication are really admirable, John. It's okay to acknowledge the difficulty and seek help when you need it.

p18/p18_conv_1:2.speaker: seeker
p18/p18_conv_1:2.text: Honestly, things have been a bit tough lately.

p18/p18_conv_1:20.speaker: seeker
p18/p18_conv_1:20.text: Thanks for saying that. I often worry if I'm doing enough.

p18/p18_conv_1:21.speaker: supporter
p18/p18_conv_1:21.text: Your dedication is clear, and you're definitely doing a lot. Remember, it’s okay to lean on others and share the burden.

p18/p18_conv_1:22.speaker: seeker
p18/p18_conv_1:22.text: I suppose you're right. I might talk to my siblings about splitting the responsibilities more evenly.

p18/p18_conv_1:23.speaker: supporter
p18/p18_conv_1:23.text: That sounds like a constructive step. Having a supportive team can make a big difference.

p18/p18_conv_1:24.speaker: seeker
p18/p18_conv_1:24.text: Yeah, I’ll reach out to them. Thanks for listening and helping me process everything.

p18/p18_conv_1:25.speaker: supporter
p18/p18_conv_1:25.text: Anytime, John. I'm here whenever you need to talk. Take care of yourself and let me know how things go.

p18/p18_conv_1:26.speaker: seeker
p18/p18_conv_1:26.text: I will. Thanks again, you're a big help.

p18/p18_conv_1:3.speaker: supporter
p18/p18_conv_1:3.text: I'm really sorry to hear that. Do you want to talk about what's been happening?

p18/p18_conv_1:4.speaker: seeker
p18/p18_conv_1:4.text: Sure, it's my mom. She's been really sick recently, and it's been hard to manage everything.

p18/p18_conv_1:5.speaker: supporter
p18/p18_conv_1:5.text: That sounds incredibly challenging. How has her illness impacted your routine?

p18/p18_conv_1:6.speaker: seeker
p18/p18_conv_1:6.text: Well, I've been trying to juggle work and taking care of her. It's like there's not enough time in the day.

p18/p18_conv_1:7.speaker: supporter
p18/p18_conv_1:7.text: I can imagine that must be overwhelming. Have you been able to get any help with these responsibilities?

p18/p18_conv_1:8.speaker: seeker
p18/p18_conv_1:8.text: A little. Some family members have chipped in, but I still feel like I'm carrying most of the load.

p18/p18_conv_1:9.speaker: supporter
p18/p18_conv_1:9.text: It's really important to have support. How are you taking care of yourself in all of this?

p18/p18_conv_2:0.speaker: supporter
p18/p18_conv_2:0.text: Hi John, I saw your message. How are you holding up today?

p18/p18_conv_2:1.speaker: seeker
p18/p18_conv_2:1.text: Hey. I'm okay, I guess. Just trying to get through the day.

p18/p18_conv_2:10.speaker: supporter
p18/p18_conv_2:10.text: I understand. It's a delicate balance, but you both care about each other and that's important support.

p18/p18_conv_2:11.speaker: seeker
p18/p18_conv_2:11.text: True. I guess I just wish I could do more for mom. It's frustrating feeling so helpless.

p18/p18_conv_2:12.speaker: supporter
p18/p18_conv_2:12.text: Those feelings are perfectly valid, John. You're doing a lot already, and sometimes just being there is what matters most.

p18/p18_conv_2:13.speaker: seeker
p18/p18_conv_2:13.text: I know you're right. It's just hard not to feel guilty about it, like I could be doing something more.

p18/p18_conv_2:14.speaker: supporter
p18/p18_conv_2:14.text: It's understandable, but try to be kind to yourself. Remember, you're human and there's only so much you can do.

p18/p18_conv_2:15.speaker: seeker
p18/p18_conv_2:15.text: Thanks for saying that. I sometimes forget to give myself a break.

p18/p18_conv_2:16.speaker: supporter
p18/p18_conv_2:16.text: It's important to take care of yourself too. Have you found any small ways to relax or unwind?

p18/p18_conv_2:17.speaker: seeker
p18/p18_conv_2:17.text: I've been trying to get back into reading before bed. It's been a nice escape.

p18/p18_conv_2:18.speaker: supporter
p18/p18_conv_2:18.text: That sounds like a lovely way to disconnect for a bit. Keep making time for yourself when you can.

p18/p18_conv_2:19.speaker: seeker
p18/p18_conv_2:19.text: I'll try. Thanks again for listening. It helps to know I'm not alone in this.

p18/p18_conv_2:2.speaker: supporter
p18/p18_conv_2:2.text: I remember you mentioned your mom wasn't well. How's she doing?

p18/p18_conv_2:20.speaker: supporter
p18/p18_conv_2:20.text: Anytime, John. You're doing your best and that's important to remember. I'm here if you need to talk.

p18/p18_conv_2:3.speaker: seeker
p18/p18_conv_2:3.text: She's hanging in there, but her condition hasn't really improved. It's been hard to see her like this.

p18/p18_conv_2:4.speaker: supporter
p18/p18_conv_2:4.text: I'm really sorry to hear that, John. That must be tough on you.

p18/p18_conv_2:5.speaker: seeker
p18/p18_conv_2:5.text: Yeah, it is. I feel like I'm constantly juggling work and making sure she's okay. It's just exhausting.

p18/p18_conv_2:6.speaker: supporter
p18/p18_conv_2:6.text: It sounds overwhelming. Have you been able to talk to anyone about it, like your sister Annie?

p18/p18_conv_2:7.speaker: seeker
p18/p18_conv_2:7.text: I did, last week actually. She's been supportive, but I think she's also really worried.

p18/p18_conv_2:8.speaker: supporter
p18/p18_conv_2:8.text: It's good you have someone to talk to. How did it feel to share your concerns with her?

p18/p18_conv_2:9.speaker: seeker
p18/p18_conv_2:9.text: It felt nice to get it off my chest, but sometimes I worry I'm burdening her too much.

p18/p18_conv_3:0.speaker: supporter
p18/p18_conv_3:0.text: Hi John, how are you holding up? I've been thinking about you.

p18/p18_conv_3:1.speaker: seeker
p18/p18_conv_3:1.text: Hi, thanks for checking in. Things have been a bit rough lately.

p18/p18_conv_3:10.speaker: supporter
p18/p18_conv_3:10.text: That makes sense. It's great that you're trying to balance it as a team. Maybe setting smaller, manageable goals could help?

p18/p18_conv_3:11.speaker: seeker
p18/p18_conv_3:11.text: That might be a good idea. I’ve been feeling so overwhelmed that even small tasks feel monumental.

p18/p18_conv_3:12.speaker: supporter
p18/p18_conv_3:12.text: It’s okay to feel overwhelmed. Give yourself permission to tackle things at your own pace. What do you think might help ease this feeling?

p18/p18_conv_3:13.speaker: seeker
p18/p18_conv_3:13.text: I think finding some time to rest would make a difference, but I feel guilty stepping away, even for a moment.

p18/p18_conv_3:14.speaker: supporter
p18/p18_conv_3:14.text: Taking care of yourself is really important too, even if it feels challenging. You deserve that time to recharge.

p18/p18_conv_3:15.speaker: seeker
p18/p18_conv_3:15.text: I know you’re right. I just need to find the courage to actually do it.

p18/p18_conv_3:16.speaker: supporter
p18/p18_conv_3:16.text: Courage is making the best choice for yourself, even when it's hard. You’ve shown strength in so many ways already.

p18/p18_conv_3:17.speaker: seeker
p18/p18_conv_3:17.text: Thanks for saying that. I guess hearing it from someone else makes it feel more valid.

p18/p18_conv_3:18.speaker: supporter
p18/p18_conv_3:18.text: Absolutely. Remember, asking for help is a sign of strength, not weakness.

p18/p18_conv_3:19.speaker: seeker
p18/p18_conv_3:19.text: I’ll try to remember that. I really appreciate you listening.

p18/p18_conv_3:2.speaker: supporter
p18/p18_conv_3:2.text: I'm sorry to hear that. Do you want to talk about what's been happening?

p18/p18_conv_3:20.speaker: supporter
p18/p18_conv_3:20.text: I'm always here to listen, John. You're doing the best you can, and that’s enough.

p18/p18_conv_3:3.speaker: seeker
p18/p18_conv_3:3.text: Well, my mom had a health relapse and it's just been really tough managing everything.

p18/p18_conv_3:4.speaker: supporter
p18/p18_conv_3:4.text: That sounds incredibly difficult. With everything you have on your plate, it must be overwhelming.

p18/p18_conv_3:5.speaker: seeker
p18/p18_conv_3:5.text: Yeah, it is. I feel like I’m constantly juggling work, family, and just trying to hold it all together.

p18/p18_conv_3:6.speaker: supporter
p18/p18_conv_3:6.text: It's understandable to feel that way. You're dealing with a lot. How has your sister been handling it?

p18/p18_conv_3:7.speaker: seeker
p18/p18_conv_3:7.text: Annie's been supportive, as always. We talk often, which helps, but I can tell she's stressed too.

p18/p18_conv_3:8.speaker: supporter
p18/p18_conv_3:8.text: Having each other to lean on sounds helpful. Are there any strategies you both have found effective in managing this stress?

p18/p18_conv_3:9.speaker: seeker
p18/p18_conv_3:9.text: We've been trying to divide responsibilities, but it's tricky. Sometimes it feels like there's more to do than we can handle.

p18/p18_conv_4:0.speaker: supporter
p18/p18_conv_4:0.text: Hey John, how have you been holding up lately? I know things have been tough.

p18/p18_conv_4:1.speaker: seeker
p18/p18_conv_4:1.text: Hey, it's been a rough week. I'm just feeling overwhelmed with everything.

p18/p18_conv_4:2.speaker: supporter
p18/p18_conv_4:2.text: I'm sorry to hear that. What’s been going on?

p18/p18_conv_4:3.speaker: seeker
p18/p18_conv_4:3.text: Well, I had another argument with my manager, Mike, about my paycheck. It's really starting to weigh on me.

p18/p18_conv_4:4.speaker: supporter
p18/p18_conv_4:4.text: That sounds incredibly frustrating, especially given the ongoing issues with your pay. How did the conversation go?

p18/p18_conv_4:5.speaker: seeker
p18/p18_conv_4:5.text: Not well. We both got pretty heated, and it feels like I'm not being heard no matter how often I bring it up.

p18/p18_conv_4:6.speaker: supporter
p18/p18_conv_4:6.text: It’s understandable you'd feel overlooked. This has been going on for quite some time, hasn't it?

p18/p18_conv_4:7.speaker: seeker
p18/p18_conv_4:7.text: Yes, it's been months. On top of that, dealing with my mom's illness is just adding more stress.

p18/p18_conv_4:8.speaker: supporter
p18/p18_conv_4:8.text: Coping with both work stress and family health issues at the same time can be so exhausting. How's your mom doing now?

p18/p18_conv_4:9.speaker: seeker
p18/p18_conv_4:9.text: She had another relapse recently, so things have been pretty tough on her and us.

c1a757372b3ad0dbd07950ea8c8ee6e97d43a412.statement: received emotional support and validation from supporter during conversation

spans.speaker: seeker
